name: Silicon Valley Bank Collapse & Regional Banking Panic
description: Unprecedented deposit run and duration loss on held-to-maturity Treasury portfolios triggering the collapse of SVB and Signature Bank, causing systemic regional bank contagion.

headlines.text: SVB Financial Group launches urgent $2.25B capital raise after taking severe $1.8B after-tax loss on Treasury and MBS bond sales.
Prominent venture capital firms instruct portfolio startups to aggressively withdraw all deposits from Silicon Valley Bank as shares crater 60%.
California regulators close Silicon Valley Bank and appoint FDIC receiver in the second largest bank failure in United States history.
Treasury, Federal Reserve, and FDIC announce emergency systemic risk exception guaranteeing all uninsured deposits and creating the Bank Term Funding Program (BTFP).
Regional bank shares plunge across the board; trading halted in First Republic, Western Alliance, and PacWest amidst intense deposit flight fears.
Credit Suisse shares collapse 24% after Saudi National Bank rules out further financial assistance, sparking fears of European wholesale banking contagion.
